title: InstantiateMsg
description: InstantiateMsg configures the contract on initialization.

allowlist_contract.description: Contract address of the allow-list contract that manages the list of addresses allowed or passed KYC to mint maxBTC

deposit_cost.description: One-off cost (Decimal) charged when a user deposits to mint maxBTC

deposit_decimals.description: Number of decimals carried by the `deposit_denom` asset

deposit_denom.description: Denom for user deposits (e.g. IBC-transferred BTC)

deposit_flush_period.description: Minimum number of seconds that must elapse between two deposit-flush operations

deposit_pump_contract.description: Contract that forwards freshly-received deposits to the custody chain.

deposits_cap.description: Upper limit on total AUM; deposits are rejected once the cap (if present) is exceeded

exchange_rate_provider_contract.description: This contract provides the exchange rate for maxBTC

fee_collector_params.description: Instantiation parameters for the fee collector.

maxbtc_denom.description: The token-factory sub-denom used for the maxBTC token

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)

FeeMinterParams.description: New struct to hold parameters for instantiating the fee collector contract.

code_id.description: The code ID of the fee collector contract wasm.

collection_period_seconds.description: The duration in hours for each fee collection period.

fee_apy_reduction_percentage.description: The percentage of APY to be taken as a fee.

salt.description: A unique salt for generating a predictable address with Instantiate2.
